title: For decorating purposes only; in my opinion
text: For decorating purposes only; in my opinion. I think that $42.99 plus tax is way too expensive for this lightweight tray. The slats in the bottom are warped rendering it impossible to use it for other than decorating purposes.

product_metadata.title: Large 20 x 14 Inch Ottoman Tray, Distressed White Farmhouse, Solid Pine Serving Tray with Padded Feet and Bronze Handles by Boxwood Brothers
features: ✔️SOLID PINE WOOD - Unlike others, our trays are made ONLY from solid pine, NEVER fir or paulownia
✔️STAIN RESISTANT - Coated with stain resistant varnish, serve tea or coffee with no fear of damage
✔️STURDY HANDLES - Strong bronze handles set off the farmhouse look with beautiful functionality
✔️DECORATIVE ACCENTS - Bronze corner pieces and matching handles add to the beauty of each tray
✔️STUNNING USABILITY - With padded corner feet, trays are lovely AND useful, a great versatile piece
description: 💠Our trays are made of SOLID PINE WOOD! We chose to use pine because we feel it is a prettier than fir and more sturdy wood than the paulowina that our competitors are using; specifically in regards to how securely the screws stay in place for the handles and for its natural beauty. We feel, through our own testing and research, that paulowina is not as durable or as functional and pine has more character than fir.💠Each serving tray is coated with a stain resistant clear coat to allow usability without fear of damaging the natural beauty of the wood. So, go ahead and serve tea or coffee with confidence!💠Our strong and ornate bronze handles set off the farmhouse look with beautiful functionality. The decorative matching corner pieces add to the beauty of each tray to give it a rustic farmhouse or shabby chic appeal that works with a variety of home decor.💠With padded corner feet, our Boxwood Brothers ottoman serving trays are not only lovely AND useful, they will keep your furniture safe from scratches. Use it as a decorative centerpiece or to serve breakfast in bed, you will be highly satisfied with this great versatile piece.💠Boxwood Brothers is a veteran owned business that does all product design and testing in the US. We only source our products from the highest quality vendors in the world.
